description: This Java source file defines the EnforcerActor class, an Akka actor responsible for enforcing policies and access controls (ACLs) on signals within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for actor creation and stream graph setup for processing enforcement tasks.

classes.name: EnforcerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for enforcing security policies on incoming signals, managing enforcement tasks via stream processing graphs, and coordinating with enforcement providers.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates actor Props for an EnforcerActor instance with specified dependencies and caches.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Returns the sink that processes enforcement tasks by creating a stream graph that broadcasts incoming messages to enforcement providers and schedules enforcement tasks.

methods.name: assembleSink
methods.description: Builds a stream graph that enforces policies by broadcasting messages to multiple enforcement providers, optionally applying a pre-enforcement step, and scheduling enforcement tasks.
